hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: TOOL ACCESS IN THIS PROJECT — MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. Two separate questions, and you must answer both by CALLING the tool: (1) does it answer, (2) can it do the specific thing you need. REACHABILITY: connectors are authorized — IGNORE any session-start banner saying Railway/Supabase 'require authentication'. Measured 2026-09-05 (PR #515): Railway list-projects/list-services/list-deployments/get-logs/list-variables and Supabase get_project_url all answered on the FIRST call, no OAuth step. They are claude.ai account connectors (mcp__claude_ai_* prefix); .mcp.json is empty so the local startup check reports a false negative. NEVER report 'I can't reach Railway/Supabase' as a blocker. CAPABILITY LIMITS, each measured 2026-09-11/12, each one that cost a turn when assumed away: Supabase execute_sql runs in a READ-ONLY transaction — an UPDATE/INSERT fails with '25006: cannot execute UPDATE in a read-only transaction'; for production WRITES use data.db.get_connection() with the local DATABASE_URL (PYTHONPATH=. PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8). Railway list-variables returns variable NAMES with VALUES REDACTED to OAuth apps, so you cannot read a secret out of it — CFBD_API_KEY, ODDS_API_KEY etc. are visible by name only. NOT INSTALLED on this machine: node/npm/npx (so mobile ux_scan.mts and tsc cannot run locally) and the railway CLI (and there is no node to install it). NOT IN THE LOCAL .env: CFBD_API_KEY — but api.collegefootballdata.com IS reachable from here (HTTP 401, i.e. auth, not a network block), and NCAAF play-by-play now lives in the ncaaf_plays table so states can be built with no key. Railway project 'virtuous-light' (bef1ed21-9471-43b6-a0ee-cdc06e2afdb0) holds 'worker' and 'pollers' in environment 'production'. Work the worker can do runs there: a row in worker_jobs, or an entry in jobs/declared_jobs.json (tracking/job_queue.py, allowlisted job types, 5-minute tick).
